build_load_extracted_features: build a function to load and merge multi-GPU extracted features from a directory for a given split and layer
create_get_shard_file_names: create a function to discover and list shard file paths matching a split and layer pattern in a directory
run_sample_features_reservoir: run reservoir sampling to extract a random subset of features without loading all data into memory
create_map_features_to_image_paths: create a function to map extracted features back to their original image filenames and save per-image feature files
test_load_feature_shard: test loading a single feature shard file containing features, targets, and indices numpy arrays
